'''''Cephaloziella''''' is a genus of liverworts. ''Cephaloziella varians'' <small>(Gottsche) Steph.</small> is the only liverwort that occurs in the continental Antarctic. <ref>{{cite journal | author = Newsham KK. | year = 2010 | title = The biology and ecology of the liverwort ''Cephaloziella varians'' in Antarctica | journal = Antarctic Science | volume = 22 | issue = 2 | pages = 131–143 | doi = 10.1017/S0954102009990630| url = http://nora.nerc.ac.uk/id/eprint/10605/1/-ANS-ANS22_02-S0954102009990630a.pdf }}</ref>
